claims: There are 38 federally recognized Native American tribes headquartered in Oklahoma.
The Cherokee Nation has over 450,000 citizens.
The Cherokee Nation is the largest federally recognized Native American tribe headquartered in Oklahoma.
The Choctaw Nation, Chickasaw Nation, Muscogee (Creek) Nation, and Seminole Nation have significant sovereign reservation lands following the 2020 McGirt v. Oklahoma Supreme Court ruling.
The Cherokee Nation is based in Tahlequah.
The Cherokee Nation is the largest tribe in the US.
The Cherokee Nation covers 16 counties in northeastern Oklahoma.
The Choctaw Nation of Oklahoma is headquartered in Durant.
The Choctaw Nation of Oklahoma covers 10.5 counties in southeastern Oklahoma.
The Chickasaw Nation is located in south-central Oklahoma.
The Chickasaw Nation has headquarters in Ada.
The Muscogee Nation is based in Okmulgee.
The Muscogee Nation represents the Muscogee (Creek) people.
The Seminole Nation of Oklahoma is located in Seminole County.
The Osage Nation is headquartered in Pawhuska.
The Citizen Potawatomi Nation is a tribe in Oklahoma.
The Apache Tribe of Oklahoma is a tribe in Oklahoma.
The Delaware Nation is a tribe in Oklahoma.
